title: #aurora-infra – chat excerpt (Payline certificate)
context_note: Partial export: the thread continues with 2 replies that were not included in the export.
content:
[18:22] Infrastructure Engineer: fyi re the Payline cert for the Meridian portal domain – renewal needs a signed CSR from the client side, not from us. Their domain, their CA account.

[18:23] Infrastructure Engineer: I pinged someone at Meridian last week, no answer yet. Not sure who owns this on our side now that the previous security contact left – maybe Security team? Or the account team?

[18:24] Infrastructure Engineer: anyway it expires on the 20th. If it lapses, card payments in the portal stop working.

[2 more replies not included in this export]
